headline: EPS rises sequentially, little changed year-over-year
summary_short: LG Uplus reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₩517, up 24.0% q/q from ₩417 and roughly flat y/y versus ₩510.
summary_long: EPS of ₩517 rose 24.0% sequentially from ₩417 and was little changed year-over-year, up 1.4% from ₩510. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
